shipped.what: the shipped ranking (search graph) on the graph without the entities step

extraction.priced_by: no entities step: no model call at build

hybrid.what: search hybrid (EVO_KG_EMBEDDINGS=openrouter) on the graph without the entities step

extraction.priced_by: no entities step: no model call at build

compare_holdout.command: kg bench compare musique-shipped.json musique-hybrid.json --split holdout
text: set            metric          n  before   after     diff      se  ci95

entities.what: the shipped ranking on the multi-hop strategy's graph, entities step included, walk left out

cost.what: the answers of the entities step in the graphs' memo, every build of them (a run calls no model)

extraction.priced_by: the cost Claude Code reported, else the mapping's price

compare_holdout.command: kg bench compare musique-shipped.json musique-entities.json --split holdout
text: set            metric          n  before   after     diff      se  ci95

multi-hop.what: the multi-hop strategy whole: its entity graph asked with its walk (--settings walk.json)

cost.what: the answers of the entities step in the graphs' memo, every build of them (a run calls no model)

extraction.priced_by: the cost Claude Code reported, else the mapping's price

compare_holdout.command: kg bench compare musique-shipped.json musique-multihop.json --split holdout
text: set            metric          n  before   after     diff      se  ci95

note: MuSiQue (7,921 documents, 301 tune and 158 holdout questions), four configs. The entity graph was built once with the multi-hop strategy (Claude Haiku 5.5 through the machine's Claude Code subscription, sink clear public, cap 18 USD under the plan's 20); entities and multi-hop ask that same graph, multi-hop with the strategy's walk added back by --settings. Extraction cost is read from the graph's memo (corpus.extraction), every build together; hybrid's OpenRouter embedding calls are not metered here. medical needs pyarrow, which is not installed, and literature does not fit the cap, so neither ran.
